posts.cooked:

Dear Course team - please advise how / where to get the information required to answer this GA2.4 ? As I cannot see the lecture L2.4 has this level of detail - it doesn’t provide this for SSH - nor there is any supplementary / tutorial on this.

Is there any expectation that we experiment with SSH to find out and learn by trial and error, and then answer the GA questions?

Appreciate your prompt response.

Thanks

Puneet

Also, I was not able to run SSH, ifconfig and netstat on my Ubuntu, when I try to install net tools it gives me error about some dependencies etc., tried the suggested update etc. , no joy
Do you have a support channel to help with Linux package install problems?

thanks again!

posts.name: Puneet
posts.cooked:
Hi,

No problem, they were introduced to help you guys with basic stuffs.

Regards,
Puneet

posts.name: Puneet
posts.cooked:
Hi,

You have to use sudo command in front apt install to install new packages.

Try this -

sudo apt install net-tools

and
then run this -

sudo apt --fix-broken install

Try these methods, and let me know if you face any other challenges.

Regards,
Puneet

posts.name: Johnson Philips
posts.cooked:
@Puneet_21f3002005 , @hemalatha

OK thanks; however I went to the TA sessions live link, found the latest video in there called ‘Week1 review’, which was saying 1 day ago -
listened to this recorded session, and came to know that we have to set up the IITM Virtual Machine(VM) following the instructions provided in the live call, and even further surprise was that there are weekly assignments released through the VM which also are to be worked on and submitted, on top of the ‘Graded Assignment-weekno’, GrPAs we get through the system commands weekly course portal??? My understanding was that the BPTs are the only ones to be solved in addition to the GrPAs we get via the course portal…??

It is really something which was not communicated by any other means - and if I did not listen to this I would’ve missed it altogether - can you please issue a clear communication via SC dashboard inbox / emails with all these details and assignment submission requirements / processes???
Also how would one know that such super important instructions and VM link etc are given over live Gmeet session?? Many of us are working professionals / fulltime students doing this course as well, which doesn’t allow us to always attend live sessions or sometimes we may not be able to listen to 2.5 hours of live discussions involving repeated guidance to many students, given that we are limited in time but be fair with all students in terms of communicating such important instructions and guidance…

Hope you would understand this situation and provide the necessary comms so that we don’t miss any of the mandatory activities / instructions.

Thank you very much course team!

Update - just now I noticed a link called ‘VM Access’ under the general instructions& important links tab - but still my concerns raised above need to be addressed please - as bumping into something/finding critical stuff by accident is not the same as getting it properly communicated to us - kindly consider this - thanks very much for your understanding and continued support to us…

posts.name: Johnson Philips
posts.cooked:
@hemalatha @Puneet_21f3002005

To the advice given to me to go through the student gradebook , I checked it(the Sep2024 Grading document) again - it has weekly assignments(which I believe are the ones in the Course portal called GAs and GrPAs, not the assignments through VMs) , BPTs and OPPEs, but nothing mentioned about the VM based weekly assignment which also has to be submitted as per the TA session week1 review;
So I request you to kindly read the post in full before responding with a 1 liner answer, which doesn’t help / give any clarity.

Thanks for your kind understanding and continued support…

PS: I followed the instructions given in the VM Access link under General instructions , and got my VM working - thanks
